defects: CONCEPT DRIFT (finance, not growth analytics): the laptop runs a STOCK-MARKET template. The header reads 'WORLD WIDE STOCK LISTING' and 'STOCK ANALYSER', there are ticker tabs (IRE / UCW / LSI), price rows ('GBB 23.3%', 'UTD 17.2%' with +/- % deltas), a scrolling quote column and a world-map 'Select region to analyze' panel (Europe / N. America / Asia...). This is the same class of defect as the round-1 FAIL (German finance text) in a video about growth vs product.

NO FUNNEL: the concept is 'a live analytics dashboard, a conversion funnel filling'. No funnel appears in any frame. The only 'filling' motion is two small bars on the chart rising between 0.05 s and 2.25 s, and that chart covers about 15% of the frame.

TEXT ON SCREEN: the header, the region names and the ticker / % rows can be made out at native 1080 width, and the spec says no text. It is small on a phone, but the large bold yellow/white header still reads as a 'stock' UI.

CLIPPED FACE AT THE LEFT EDGE: in the 0.05 s frame, a sliver of the typist's face (eye, nose, cheek) is cut by the left frame edge at about y 240-400. It drifts out of frame by 0.8 s, so the first frames open on a half-face cut at the edge. The forearm entering from the left edge on every frame is natural framing and is not a defect.

WEAK SPOTLIGHT: the top ~55% of the frame is the desk lamp, a dark wall and a shelf. The dashboard, which is the actual subject, sits small in the lower-middle band (about x 380-940, y 1080-1460), so as b-roll it reads as 'lamp at night', not 'analytics'.
assets.clean: No watermark. Not blank. Real motion throughout (a slow camera drift and the hands typing). The dark blue/teal palette fits a dark video. The bottom-center caption zone is the blue desk edge and dark floor, so captions with a stroke will read.
assets.fix: Re-source an Envato clip that shows a product or growth analytics view, ideally an actual funnel or conversion bars filling, with no readable finance or ticker labels and no partial faces at the frame edge, and where the screen fills most of the portrait frame. Trimming the in-point past ~0.8 s removes the clipped face, but the stock-market UI and the missing funnel remain. If Mike waives the concept, use it only from >=0.8 s.

advisory: Native size is 941x1672, not the 1080x1920 the label says. The aspect is exact 9:16 (0.5628), so Remotion upscales it about 1.15x with no meaningful crop. This matches the accepted longform IMG set.

There is one subject and it fills the portrait frame. The bottom ~15% is a dark reflective floor, which works for captions. Mean luma is 73 and white is 0.8%, so it is not blank.

assets.checks: Concept matches: photoreal and cinematic, a lone founder seen from behind at a desk late at night. A warm rim light from the desk lamp catches his hair and shoulder, and a city-night bokeh window is behind. Two monitors glow fully out of focus, showing colour blur only with no readable UI or text. No text or watermark anywhere. The head and shoulders sit fully inside the frame.
